<p>
This is 
an end-to-end workflow that walks through analyzing a WTX single slide dataset 
-- from loading flat files
to quality processing to performing Pathway analysis -- using open-sourced tools in a blend of R and python. In here 
you will find best practices, interactive visualizations to show what effects
certain processing parameters have on the data, and applications to cutting-edge
tools that have described in our blog like HieraType. 
</p>
